title: Veriqo — complete-product implementation plan
scope: Production end-to-end testing across web, APIs, AI agents, Android/iOS, desktop and voice; cross-application workflows and private runners required.
status: Proposed implementation; all engineering tasks planned, none verified complete

assumptions.estimation_note: Preliminary effort ranges, not committed elapsed durations. Re-estimate after native/device/voice feasibility work; account for role bottlenecks.

milestones.title: Shared platform
milestones.goal: Identity, versioned contracts, durable execution and the authenticated console.
milestones.gate: A scoped user runs a real synthetic action and independent checks distinguish correct, duplicate, missing and wrong-tenant outcomes.
milestones.qa: Approve business expectations and matrix; maintain separate development and assessment fixtures.

milestones.title: Integration and private execution
milestones.goal: Connections, adapters, fixtures, protected evidence and enrolled private runners.
milestones.gate: A conformance-tested adapter executes through cloud and private runners with bounded permissions, safe retries and visible cleanup.
milestones.qa: Approve credential/network scope and observer coverage; review runner enrollment and recovery evidence.

milestones.title: Web and API execution
milestones.goal: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, REST, GraphQL, WebSocket and multi-target workflows.
milestones.gate: Browser-initiated and endpoint-initiated workflows detect backend defects across the qualified browser/API matrix.
milestones.qa: Review independent web/API outcomes and legitimate asynchronous behavior.

milestones.title: AI-agent execution
milestones.goal: HTTP, initial SDK bridge, MCP, telemetry, multi-turn sessions and multi-agent handoffs.
milestones.gate: Agent responses, internal events and actual business effects remain separately assessed under bounded execution.
milestones.qa: Label context, authorization, recovery and handoff cases; approve capability disclosures.

milestones.title: Android and iOS execution
milestones.goal: Appium adapters, simulator/emulator and real-device integration, fixtures and mobile evidence.
milestones.gate: A mobile-to-agent-to-API-to-web journey passes and seeded faults fail on the committed Android/iOS matrix.
milestones.qa: Supply signed synthetic apps/device access and validate host, privacy and cost constraints.

milestones.title: Desktop execution
milestones.goal: Windows, macOS, Linux and Electron adapters with isolated profiles and OS-specific bridges.
milestones.gate: Desktop-initiated workflows have reproducible evidence and verified outcomes on every committed OS/technology cell.
milestones.qa: Approve accessible test interfaces and OS permissions; measure native-bridge support requirements.

milestones.title: Voice execution
milestones.goal: WebRTC audio, transcripts, interruptions, business outcomes, escalation and privacy controls.
milestones.gate: Voice-triggered actions and agent handoffs are independently verified with audio uncertainty and timing limits disclosed.
milestones.qa: Approve synthetic/consented fixtures, languages, timing expectations and speech-provider data routes.

milestones.title: Complete customer product
milestones.goal: Authoring, datasets, schedules, comparisons, advisory assistance, CI/CD, billing and self-service onboarding.
milestones.gate: An independent user connects, configures, runs, investigates, fixes and reruns with documented commercial and release controls.
milestones.qa: Approve templates, commercial allowances and operator usability; no founder operation is assumed.

milestones.title: Production qualification and launch
milestones.goal: Independent assessments, cross-application qualification, capacity, security, recovery and documentation.
milestones.gate: All six application classes and committed cross-application journeys meet the general-availability gates.
milestones.qa: Sign the evidence-backed release decision; customer count and revenue are not engineering acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Approve product outcomes and the compatibility matrix
tasks.deliverable: Versioned business requirements and supported-platform matrix for all six application classes.
acceptance_criteria: Define positive, forbidden and uncertain outcomes for web, API, agent, mobile, desktop and voice journeys.
Record required OS/browser/device versions, integration prerequisites and evidence limits; all cells start Planned.
QA/domain owner approves expectations independently of generated implementation behavior.

tasks.title: Bootstrap the workspace, CI and AWS EU environments
tasks.deliverable: Pinned TypeScript workspace, local dependencies, infrastructure as code and separated AWS Ireland environments.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh checkout starts PostgreSQL, local Temporal and synthetic target fixtures.
CI checks types, formatting, relevant tests, schema compatibility and migration smoke execution.
Pin Node, package manager, images and browsers; keep secrets outside source and separate development, staging and production.

tasks.title: Publish multi-target scenario, adapter and event contracts
tasks.deliverable: Versioned schemas for scenarios, bindings, capabilities, events, findings and result manifests.
acceptance_criteria: Steps reference target aliases and typed outputs without embedding credentials or arbitrary code.
Include deadlines, operation/attempt IDs, execution identity and explicit unavailable evidence.
Separate execution status, correctness verdict, evidence completeness and cleanup status; validate examples for every application class.

tasks.title: Implement organisations, identity and scoped permissions
tasks.deliverable: Cognito OIDC integration, memberships, owner/editor/viewer roles and revocable project service tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated membership establishes tenant scope on every read, write, export and download.
Only authorized roles publish criteria, manage connections or change release policy.
Test guessed identifiers, revoked users/tokens and cross-project access using non-owner database roles.

tasks.title: Build immutable persistence and transactional run admission
tasks.deliverable: SQL migrations, versioned records, frozen multi-target manifests and a transactional outbox.
acceptance_criteria: Composite tenant references reject cross-organisation relationships.
Run creation and dispatch command commit atomically; scoped idempotency key plus changed payload returns conflict.
Published scenario, dataset, target, evaluator and policy versions remain unchanged after edits.

tasks.title: Implement durable workflow stages and result fencing
tasks.deliverable: Temporal dispatcher, stage machine, task assignment, cancellation and stale-completion rejection.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated outbox delivery starts one logical run; workflow code performs no nondeterministic network work.
Fence assignments by attempt and lease; preserve late evidence without accepting stale terminal completion.
Worker death or ambiguous external write yields reconciliation or inconclusive execution, never automatic replay of unsafe writes.

tasks.title: Enforce budgets, concurrency and usage accounting
tasks.deliverable: Atomic reservations, per-organisation limits, deadlines, payload caps and append-only usage events.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent run starts cannot exceed reserved budgets or configured tenant concurrency.
Enforce controllable duration, turn and call limits outside model instructions; label opaque agent costs unavailable.
Account for all attempts, in-flight work and reconciled versus estimated consumption; reject excess work explicitly.

tasks.title: Deliver the authenticated project and run console
tasks.deliverable: Project management, run submission, polling, cancellation and a real evidence-backed run detail.
acceptance_criteria: A user creates and inspects a run without direct database access.
Display execution, verdict, coverage, platform identity and cleanup independently.
Polling stops on terminal execution; unauthorized users cannot inspect results or artifact references.

tasks.title: Implement versioned connections and secret resolution
tasks.deliverable: Connection registration, health diagnosis, target versions, secret rotation and deployment identity.
acceptance_criteria: Distinguish invalid credentials, blocked networking, unsupported capabilities and unavailable identity.
Store secret references; resolve authorized secret versions at execution and record version identity without values.
Validate deployment/build identities per bound target; redact credentials before evidence leaves its trusted boundary.

tasks.title: Build the adapter registry and compatibility negotiation
tasks.deliverable: Shared capability registry and prepare/invoke/observe/cancel/cleanup lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Pin adapter version and platform requirements in each run manifest.
Reject missing mandatory capabilities before publication/admission; label excluded optional checks NOT_TESTED.
Conformance suite rejects invented telemetry, invalid outputs, expired sessions and over-limit payloads.

tasks.title: Implement fixtures, compensation and cleanup reconciliation
tasks.deliverable: Per-run resource namespaces, fixture ledger, cleanup workers and target quarantine.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated setup tracks one logical fixture; cleanup only touches resources owned by its namespace.
Record late writes and in-flight actions before declaring cleanup complete.
Retry failed cleanup visibly; prevent unsafe reuse of contaminated accounts, devices or targets.

tasks.title: Enforce execution isolation and destination policy
tasks.deliverable: Scoped execution assignments, Fargate task isolation and validated egress proxy policy.
acceptance_criteria: Block unapproved hosts, private/metadata destinations, unsafe DNS changes and redirect bypasses.
Browser subresources, WebSockets and child traffic cannot bypass destination rules.
Keep observer credentials separate from browser/device execution and prevent access to broad platform credentials.

tasks.title: Deliver customer-managed private runners
tasks.deliverable: Outbound authenticated job retrieval, enrolled runner identities, upgrades and scoped result export.
acceptance_criteria: Assignments bind tenant, project, manifest, capabilities, lease and expiration; runner revocation stops new work.
Cloud control service gains no arbitrary inbound access to customer networks.
Handle disconnection, duplicate delivery and old runner versions without duplicate unsafe actions or false passes.

tasks.title: Implement protected evidence storage and event ingestion
tasks.deliverable: Append-only correlated events, S3 artifacts, sensitivity metadata and authorized short-lived access.
acceptance_criteria: Deduplicate events by producer/attempt/sequence; retain source and ingestion times without claiming a global clock order.
Validate uploads, content type, checksum and size against the scoped assignment.
Keep raw secrets out of logs; protect screenshots/audio/traces as potentially sensitive content with access and retention controls.

tasks.title: Build authoritative observers and deterministic assertions
tasks.deliverable: Approved state readers and independent count, ownership, permission, field and transition checks.
acceptance_criteria: A convincing agent reply or successful HTTP code cannot override incorrect authoritative state.
Observe through a declared window; detect delayed duplicates and distinguish incomplete reads from witnessed failures.
Observer coverage includes relevant synthetic tenants; disclose when wrong-tenant writes cannot be located.

tasks.title: Publish the adapter and runner conformance harness
tasks.deliverable: Reusable contract, fault and isolation suite required for every adapter family.
acceptance_criteria: Exercise retry before/after side effects, cancellation, credential expiry and cleanup failure.
Validate platform identity, version compatibility and capability-based admission.
Store reproducible conformance evidence with every adapter release; failed required tests block support status changes.

tasks.title: Implement REST and stateful API workflows
tasks.deliverable: REST request, schema, authentication, pagination and business-state checks.
acceptance_criteria: Use approved request templates and bounded responses; redact sensitive headers and fields.
Exercise permission denial, state transitions and timeout-after-success behavior.
Preserve expected/observed values and authoritative evidence even when the transport response is misleading.

tasks.title: Implement GraphQL operations and API contracts
tasks.deliverable: GraphQL query/mutation execution and versioned API contract checks.
acceptance_criteria: Handle partial data plus errors without converting required unknown fields into passes.
Pin operation/schema identity and enforce variable, depth and response limits.
Correlate mutations to authoritative business state with repeat-safe fixture cleanup.

tasks.title: Build isolated browser execution and artifact capture
tasks.deliverable: Playwright executor with per-run processes/contexts, authentication setup and bounded traces.
acceptance_criteria: Create fresh sessions per run; no shared customer cookies, downloads or local storage.
Enforce CPU, memory, execution deadline and child-process/network restrictions.
Use stable explicit assertions; failed launches and missing artifacts produce operational errors and unknown required checks.

tasks.title: Deliver Chromium browser-initiated journeys
tasks.deliverable: Login, submit request, verify API state and confirm final UI in one protected scenario.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow can begin in the browser or through an agent endpoint using the same business requirement.
Backend count/tenant failures remain failures even when the screen appears correct.
Record actual browser/application builds, fixtures, screenshot and reproduction input.

tasks.title: Qualify Firefox and WebKit execution
tasks.deliverable: Published browser/version matrix and shared journey execution across three engines.
acceptance_criteria: Run known-good and seeded-bad workflows on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
Explain engine-specific exclusions; Playwright WebKit results do not automatically certify every Safari/device version.
Pin browser/runner versions and preserve compatible queued execution during upgrades.

tasks.title: Support WebSocket and asynchronous application events
tasks.deliverable: Bounded WebSocket sessions and correlated asynchronous event observation.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticate and apply destination policy to upgraded connections.
Timeout, reconnect and duplicate messages retain sequence/attempt evidence.
Observe eventual state to explicit deadlines; absence of an event without sufficient coverage remains unknown.

tasks.title: Implement multi-target bindings and workflow data flow
tasks.deliverable: Validated step compiler joining applications, agent sessions, APIs and observer outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Transfer typed approved outputs through aliases; reject missing bindings and cross-project references.
Preserve business correlation across targets while recording each candidate/deployment separately.
Mixed candidate changes cannot claim a single trusted release pass; fixtures and compensation span the whole scenario.

tasks.title: Qualify web and API support with seeded failures
tasks.deliverable: Web/API compatibility report, held-out results and controlled recovery evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Detect missing writes, wrong accounts, stale UI, duplicate effects and contract failures.
Exercise browser crash, redirect attack, credential expiry and asynchronous delays.
Only tested platform/version cells advance from Planned to Qualified; unsupported cells remain explicit.

tasks.title: Implement generic HTTP agent sessions
tasks.deliverable: Versioned request/response mappings, session creation, bounded invocation and asynchronous polling.
acceptance_criteria: Support synchronous and queued responses without fabricating unobservable tool events.
Propagate deadlines and declare actual cancellation/idempotency capability.
Verify task outcome through independent observers and preserve opaque usage limitations.

tasks.title: Deliver a versioned SDK integration bridge
tasks.deliverable: First-class adapter harness with an OpenAI Agents SDK bridge as the initial reference integration.
acceptance_criteria: Pin supported SDK/protocol versions and record instrumented session/tool event coverage.
Keep customer runtime authentication scoped; bridge executes outside the control API.
Conformance tests cover missing spans, dropped events and SDK changes; telemetry does not replace outcome checking.

tasks.title: Implement scoped MCP tool integration
tasks.deliverable: MCP client adapter for approved tool servers, capability discovery and bounded calls.
acceptance_criteria: Pin a protocol revision and validate tool schemas as data rather than executable control schemas.
Enforce approved tools, destinations, argument limits and secret scope outside prompts.
Handle tool errors, cancellation and changed capabilities without inventing successful actions.

tasks.title: Normalize agent/tool telemetry and provenance
tasks.deliverable: Versioned event adapters for tool/model spans and OpenTelemetry ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: Retain original event references, producer identity, clock/source and adapter version.
Missing instrumentation is unavailable rather than proof that no action happened.
Measure observable usage across all attempts and keep reported, estimated and reconciled charges separate.

tasks.title: Implement scripted multi-turn and session-memory cases
tasks.deliverable: Conversation runner for clarification, correction and context retention with clean sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Reset conversation and persistent fixture memory according to the declared case contract.
Preserve exact turns, candidate settings and allowed actions under independent limits.
Detect ignored corrections and inappropriate cross-session memory using approved outcome expectations.

tasks.title: Enforce meaningful tool and agent behavior assertions
tasks.deliverable: Required/prohibited action, permission and argument checks with evidence requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Allow alternative legitimate execution paths; do not require an unnecessary exact tool sequence.
Unavailable spans make telemetry-dependent assertions unknown.
A high response-quality score cannot compensate for a witnessed prohibited action or incorrect business state.

tasks.title: Implement multi-agent handoffs across applications
tasks.deliverable: Correlated multi-agent workflow steps with explicit handoff contracts and shared business outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Track each agent identity, conversation, permissions and target candidate separately.
Exercise handoff loss, duplicate ownership, conflicting actions and escalation.
Bound each agent and overall work; propagate cancellation and cleanup across the workflow.

tasks.title: Qualify agent adapters and recovery behavior
tasks.deliverable: Agent compatibility matrix and independent assessment of action-taking workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Detect false success, unauthorized action, duplicate write, stale context and handoff defects.
Test timeouts before action and after success without masking intermittent failures.
Publish per-adapter capabilities and version limits; generic HTTP support is not automatic support for every framework.

tasks.title: Validate mobile infrastructure and device eligibility
tasks.deliverable: Appium-based mobile runner design and measured emulator, macOS host and real-device feasibility.
acceptance_criteria: Publish Android/iOS versions, required app builds, signing, permissions and device availability.
Document Appium driver versions and supported public accessibility/test interfaces.
Validate device provider/private-host credentials, EU data routes and cost before approving the mobile forecast.

tasks.title: Implement Android application execution
tasks.deliverable: Android runner using Appium UiAutomator2 for install, launch, interaction and evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Execute native and supported hybrid app workflows against pinned emulator/device images.
Collect app build, OS/device identity, logs and screenshots under per-run scope.
Handle denied permissions, lost device, crash and app reset as explicit execution outcomes.

tasks.title: Implement iOS application execution
tasks.deliverable: iOS runner using Appium XCUITest on enrolled macOS simulator/device hosts.
acceptance_criteria: Validate signing, provisioning, app build and supported Xcode/OS versions before dispatch.
Use dedicated sessions and approved test interfaces for app actions and authentication.
Device disconnect, expired provisioning and automation denial cannot produce a passing business verdict.

tasks.title: Implement mobile fixture and session lifecycle
tasks.deliverable: Per-run application data, accounts, permission state and cleanup on Android and iOS.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated runs start from declared clean state and do not share tokens, media or notifications.
Support deep-link/navigation setup only within approved application permissions.
Quarantine devices with uncertain cleanup and retain an auditable reconciliation record.

tasks.title: Deliver mobile-to-agent-to-backend-to-web workflows
tasks.deliverable: Cross-application scenario initiated on mobile with agent/API outcomes and web confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Correlate the business entity across mobile, agent, observer and browser target bindings.
Seed wrong-account, duplicate submission and delayed synchronization defects.
Preserve each application build and evidence trail; one surface cannot erase another required failure.

tasks.title: Integrate real-device scheduling and leases
tasks.deliverable: Device allocation, exclusive leases, queued capacity and provider/private-host integration.
acceptance_criteria: Prevent two assignments sharing an exclusive device or leaking prior session data.
Account for allocated, failed and idle billable device time with provider provenance.
Handle lease loss, cancellation and release failure without accepting stale task completion.

tasks.title: Collect correlated mobile evidence and reproduction
tasks.deliverable: Screenshots, bounded video/logs, action timeline and build/device reproduction manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Minimize sensitive recording and authorize every download/export.
Align actions with API/agent observations without assuming synchronized clocks.
Missing recordings remain visible and produce unknown checks only where that evidence is required.

tasks.title: Qualify Android and iOS product support
tasks.deliverable: Per-version emulator/real-device conformance and end-to-end assessment report.
acceptance_criteria: Run known-good and seeded-defect cases on each committed Android/iOS matrix cell.
Exercise app crash, device loss, stale state, permission change and cleanup failure.
No mobile support cell is complete until outcome, isolation, recovery and reproduction gates pass.

tasks.title: Validate desktop automation and OS host requirements
tasks.deliverable: Desktop runner feasibility report and signed native accessibility-bridge interfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Specify Windows UI Automation, macOS Accessibility and Linux AT-SPI support boundaries.
Identify OS versions, interactive sessions, display requirements, packaging and automation permissions.
Measure native-bridge effort and host costs; revise estimates before committing production dates.

tasks.title: Implement Windows desktop execution
tasks.deliverable: Enrolled Windows runner with an allowlisted UI Automation bridge and isolated user session.
acceptance_criteria: Launch pinned application builds, interact through supported controls and collect evidence.
Validate session locks, elevation boundaries and application permissions before dispatch.
Crash, inaccessible controls and host disconnect preserve honest execution and cleanup status.

tasks.title: Implement macOS desktop execution
tasks.deliverable: Enrolled macOS runner with a signed Accessibility bridge and per-run profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Validate accessibility/screen-capture consent and application signing before execution.
Restrict actions to approved application processes and accessible elements.
Permission revocation, screen lock and application crash do not become business passes.

tasks.title: Implement Linux desktop execution
tasks.deliverable: Linux runner using an AT-SPI bridge on a qualified desktop/display stack.
acceptance_criteria: Publish supported distribution, desktop, X11/Wayland and accessibility combinations.
Execute fixture-controlled app workflows with isolated account/profile state.
Unsupported display/control access is rejected before execution or recorded as missing required capability.

tasks.title: Integrate Electron application execution
tasks.deliverable: Playwright-backed adapter for supported Electron application builds.
acceptance_criteria: Pin Electron/app versions and distinguish browser-renderer checks from native OS behavior.
Keep main-process permissions and local file access within runner policy.
Verify business outcome through an independent observer and preserve native-bridge fallback limits.

tasks.title: Implement desktop profiles, leases and cleanup
tasks.deliverable: Exclusive desktop-host/session allocation, per-run user data and cleanup reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Do not share credential stores, clipboard content, files or background processes across runs.
Recover host disconnect and locked sessions without unsafe repeated business actions.
Quarantine hosts with uncertain cleanup; cancellation tracks remaining processes and side effects.

tasks.title: Deliver desktop-to-agent-to-API workflows
tasks.deliverable: Desktop business journey correlated with agent interaction, API state and another application.
acceptance_criteria: Record application build, OS session, agent settings and backend deployment identities.
Detect wrong-account, duplicated operation and misleading UI completion.
Export actions, expected/observed outcomes and fixture setup sufficient for another engineer to reproduce.

tasks.title: Qualify Windows, macOS and Linux desktop support
tasks.deliverable: Desktop compatibility and security report for every committed OS/application-technology cell.
acceptance_criteria: Execute independent positive and seeded-negative workflows on all committed desktop families.
Exercise host restart, application crash, permission loss and stale session completion.
Document unsupported inaccessible/custom-rendered controls without claiming universal desktop compatibility.

tasks.title: Define voice sessions and audio evidence contracts
tasks.deliverable: Versioned voice target adapter and synthetic audio/conversation fixture format.
acceptance_criteria: Specify supported session transport, audio encoding, languages and speaker-turn expectations.
Record consent/data handling, synthetic fixture provenance and latency measurement points.
Keep transcript-based quality and actual downstream task completion as separate checks.

tasks.title: Implement bounded bidirectional audio execution
tasks.deliverable: WebRTC voice adapter, audio streaming worker and scoped private-runner integration.
acceptance_criteria: Bound call duration, output audio, reconnects and concurrency outside agent instructions.
Apply approved destination/media relay policy; record actual transport/provider identities.
Connection loss and incomplete audio make required evidence unknown; retain disconnect and chargeable-duration events.

tasks.title: Capture transcripts, timestamps and audio provenance
tasks.deliverable: Versioned transcript/timing pipeline with controlled audio storage and language metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve original audio references and speech-recognition model/version where used.
Flag transcription uncertainty and clock/alignment limits rather than inventing words.
Link audio, turns, agent events and business observations under authorized artifact access.

tasks.title: Implement interruption, silence and turn-taking cases
tasks.deliverable: Repeatable voice scenarios for interruption, latency, silence, correction and clarification.
acceptance_criteria: Use labelled synthetic/consented fixtures and version timing tolerances.
Measure response onset and interruption handling from declared capture points.
Separate transport failure, transcription error, conversational quality and business action failure.

tasks.title: Verify voice-triggered business outcomes
tasks.deliverable: Voice-to-agent-to-API scenarios checked against authoritative business state.
acceptance_criteria: A spoken success statement cannot override a missing, duplicate or unauthorized action.
Correlate the created entity and identity to the audio session and fixture namespace.
Observe delayed effects through the declared window and preserve uncertain outcomes.

tasks.title: Deliver voice escalation and agent-handoff workflows
tasks.deliverable: Cross-agent voice workflow with escalation, context transfer and web/desktop confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Track the receiving agent, transferred context, ownership and conversation permissions.
Seed dropped handoff, duplicate actions and inconsistent identity defects.
Bound overall workflow duration and compensation across all affected targets.

tasks.title: Enforce audio privacy, retention and provider routing
tasks.deliverable: Voice-specific retention, access, redaction/minimization and EU provider routing policy.
acceptance_criteria: Approve speech/model/media service data routes and terms before customer content is sent.
Delete audio, transcripts and derived artifacts under tenant retention policy.
Test revoked access and sensitive-content handling; never promise perfect automatic audio redaction.

tasks.title: Qualify voice execution and outcome verification
tasks.deliverable: Voice compatibility matrix, independent labelled assessment and recovery evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Assess committed transports/languages and acoustic conditions using held-out audio cases.
Detect misleading spoken success, failed interruption, incorrect handoff and duplicate side effects.
Publish speech uncertainty, unsupported telephony protocols and provider-identity limits explicitly.

tasks.title: Deliver structured multi-application scenario authoring
tasks.deliverable: Guided form/JSON editor, target binding, validation, review and immutable publishing.
acceptance_criteria: Select approved adapter steps, fixtures, assertions and limits across all supported surfaces.
Validate typed output bindings and required capabilities without executing arbitrary user code.
Review diffs preserve protected business expectations; AI suggestions remain drafts until approved.

tasks.title: Deliver dataset import, labels and version management
tasks.deliverable: JSON/CSV import, provenance, development/calibration/assessment splits and published versions.
acceptance_criteria: Validate case fields and expected outcomes with bounded import sizes.
Enforce tenant scope and prevent holdout leakage into generation or evaluator tuning.
Every run resolves fixed cases; reviewed production examples keep redaction and fixture provenance.

tasks.title: Deliver scheduling, CLI and public execution APIs
tasks.deliverable: Schedules, asynchronous APIs, scoped CLI and JSON/JUnit exports across runner families.
acceptance_criteria: Support run, inspect, cancel, findings, compare and export with stable documented exit codes.
Schedules respect budgets, runner eligibility, tenant fairness and cancellation.
Exports preserve all attempts, NOT_TESTED/UNKNOWN results and platform/candidate manifests.

tasks.title: Deliver comparisons and cross-layer investigation
tasks.deliverable: Evidence timeline, findings explorer and matched baseline/candidate analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Display per-target versions, hard failures, incomplete cases, latency/cost and denominators.
Flag changed datasets/evaluators/environments; never pool incompatible trials into a misleading score.
Another engineer can reproduce a finding without founder operation; suspected causes remain hypotheses.

tasks.title: Add calibrated advisory AI assistance and protected repair
tasks.deliverable: Reviewable scenario suggestions, failure summaries, qualitative rubrics and locator/data repair proposals.
acceptance_criteria: Calibrate language/voice rubrics against independent labels and retain uncertainty/model identity.
Never grant permissions or change required counts, severity, ownership or release policy through generated content.
Repair proposals require review, equivalent intent and rerunning protected assertions; no silent skips or weakening.

tasks.title: Deliver revision-bound CI/CD and signed webhooks
tasks.deliverable: GitHub checks, versioned release policies, signed webhook delivery and audited expiring overrides.
acceptance_criteria: Attest each tested deployment/application build and reject stale, missing or changed identities for trusted gates.
Handle duplicate, tampered and replayed webhooks idempotently; isolate untrusted pull-request credentials.
Override requires authorized actor, reason and expiry; original failed/inconclusive result remains visible.

tasks.title: Deliver subscription and commercial usage administration
tasks.deliverable: Plan entitlements, usage allowances, metered overages, invoices and payment-provider integration.
acceptance_criteria: Reconcile all-attempt usage with billable units; distinguish estimates, adjustments and provider charges.
Payment webhook retries cannot double-charge or mutate historical usage.
Enforce configurable hard caps, disclose device/voice support costs and provide cancellation/export/offboarding flows.

tasks.title: Deliver independent customer onboarding and settings
tasks.deliverable: Self-service project setup, connection checks, runner enrollment, templates and actionable diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: User completes connect, configure, run, inspect, fix and rerun without founder/database operation.
Explain platform prerequisites, unsupported capabilities, retention and costs before execution.
Exercise billing/access revocation and offboarding; track interventions separately from completed product behavior.

tasks.title: Freeze independent assessments for every application class
tasks.deliverable: Six separate held-out assessment sets with independently approved outcomes and severity labels.
acceptance_criteria: At least 40 distinct cases per class: 20 valid, 20 seeded faults, including 10 designated critical faults.
Exclude development and calibration cases; report counts, misses, false blocks and unknowns per class.
All designated critical faults are detected; clean finite samples are smoke gates, not universal reliability claims.

tasks.title: Qualify complete cross-application business journeys
tasks.deliverable: Production-readiness evidence for mobile-to-agent-to-API-to-web, desktop-to-agent and voice-handoff workflows.
acceptance_criteria: All committed surfaces participate in correlated end-to-end journeys with independent final-state checks.
Missing mandatory stage, identity or evidence prevents a trusted release pass.
An independent operator configures, executes, investigates and reruns documented journeys using published interfaces.

tasks.title: Measure representative capacity and unit economics
tasks.deliverable: Mixed browser/device/desktop/voice/agent load benchmark and all-attempt cost model.
acceptance_criteria: Run at least 100 eligible configurations per application class at declared concurrency; include blocked/inconclusive runs in completion denominator.
At least 90 of 100 per class complete execution and required evaluation without intervention; report sample limits.
Saturation yields bounded queues or explicit rejection; measure device, compute, model, storage, orchestration and direct support costs.

tasks.title: Close production security and isolation findings
tasks.deliverable: Independent review and evidence pack for cloud, private runners, devices, OS bridges and voice data.
acceptance_criteria: No unresolved critical tenant leakage, credential exposure, uncontrolled egress or unbounded spending.
Test prompt injection, malicious URLs, artifact access, runner impersonation and OS/device session leakage.
Verify least privilege, revocation and redaction/minimization using reproducible adversarial fixtures.

tasks.title: Finish retention, deletion and audit controls
tasks.deliverable: Retention jobs and attributable access, policy, billing and runner-management audit history.
acceptance_criteria: Delete database evidence, S3 audio/video/traces, indexes and derived examples according to data-class policy.
Document backup expiry lag and evidence access after signed-link expiry/revocation.
Default raw artifacts to 14 days and run summaries to 90 days; changes require authorized configuration and audit.

tasks.title: Prove restore, rollout and operating ownership
tasks.deliverable: Measured restore exercise, compatible runner rollout and incident/cleanup runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Restore metadata plus referenced evidence and record observed recovery time and loss window.
Queued workflows and platform-specific runner versions remain compatible during deployment or use deliberate routing.
Assign incident, provider outage, runner patching, stuck cleanup and billing-reconciliation owners.

tasks.title: Publish documentation, support and compatibility evidence
tasks.deliverable: API/CLI reference, integration guides, operating limits, support matrix and offboarding documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation covers every committed browser, OS/device, voice and agent integration with tested versions.
Independent operator follows onboarding/troubleshooting/export instructions without hidden manual steps.
No unsupported matrix cell is marketed as qualified; publish measured limits rather than invented service guarantees.

tasks.title: Approve complete-product general availability
tasks.deliverable: Signed production readiness decision covering the complete committed product.
acceptance_criteria: All required web/API/agent/mobile/desktop/voice compatibility, workflow, security and operating gates have evidence.
No partial milestone, checklist tick, customer recruitment or revenue target substitutes for engineering completion.
Publish outstanding noncritical limitations, release policy, rollback/incident ownership and a versioned supported-product contract.
